assistedContinuationBrowser.method:
Native continuation pilot, prepared without starting a browser by default.

Runs unchanged production HTML and GameHandler against installed source files,
with native browser storage. Equipment is bought at a real counter, collections
use physical E interactions, and dossier actions use visible Pip-Boy buttons.
Sector/scene selection, measured camera placement, simulation freeze, resource
setup and a controlled armour impact are explicit diagnostic assistance. This
is a bounded assisted pilot, not an unassisted citywide playthrough or a survey.
assistance: Existing v020Load selects authored narrative scenes without granting equipment or quest outcomes. These scenes are not IGN replicas.
Existing v018LoadMacro/v046Load select installed geographic sectors; no lab or generated geographic fixture.
Existing v018CaptureAt places the player only at a measured or authored collision-free point, with actual line of sight.
Diagnostic Lambert inverse converts actual exported world points back to latitude/longitude for native terrain reads; it supplies no elevation.
Existing simulation/render freeze, and v047Control auto=false, make the bounded inspection repeatable.
One declared v020Seed sets caps=10000, scrap=100, circuitry=20, weaponParts=30. No armour, core, collectible, SPECIAL or quest is seeded.
Existing v046SetTime sets daytime once. Native KeyW plus v020Tick(.05,true) steps production movement under freeze.
One existing v030Hurt(40,torso) creates a declared controlled impact after actual equipment purchase; no HP restoration or free repair.
Read-only state/runtime exports inspect results. Native E, U, Tab and visible production buttons perform feature actions.
limitations: One of four new faction dossiers is completed natively. Other dossier counters are exported, not claimed complete.
One of seven figurines, one of four magazines and one of two bottle types are collected and used as appropriate.
One paid armor acquisition and one paid real-relay plate repair; failure rollback/concurrency are covered by separate VM regressions.
Reload/Continue exercises current native save migration. No fabricated historical storage import is installed.
Geographic actors, stands and lore are authored fiction placed on measured terrain; no claim of surveyed facades or rooms.
The pilot uses bounded diagnostic positioning, fixed simulation steps and seeded payment materials; it is not a human walkthrough.
An ERR_ABORTED on the exact local-data diagnostic route is retained separately as a cancelled metadata probe, with its actual stage and time. Other local failures remain fatal.

assistedArchitectureBrowser.method:
Prepared native HTTP architecture pilot. No browser starts without --run.

Uses the unchanged production HTML, GameHandler, installed source geometry and
native browser storage. One fresh context is reused through a document reload.
Existing diagnostic sector loading, measured placement, render/simulation freeze
and collision-controlled walking are declared assistance. Portal and landing
actions use real E key presses and visible buttons. This is not a human or an
unassisted citywide playthrough. No synthetic documentary plan is installed.
assistance: Existing native macro and sector loading debug APIs; no lab or geography fixture.
Existing measured collision-free camera placement and QA simulation/render freeze.
Existing v020Approach for collision/LOS checked placement before real E-key portal actions.
Native KeyW plus existing v020Tick advances production movement/collisions in fixed 0.05 s steps under QA freeze; this is assisted movement, not recorded human walking.
Landing placement on a verified clear floor precedes real E-key and visible floor/exit buttons.
Read-only debug exports inspect actual runtime annotations, geometry and interior layout.

assistedBestiaryBrowser.method:
Bounded assisted native bestiary pilot; no browser starts without --run.

Unmodified production HTML, actual GameHandler, installed map pack and native
storage. Existing sector selection, measured camera placement, daytime and
simulation/render freeze are diagnostic assistance. Public debug APIs inspect
actual streamed actors and step production physics. No actor, reward, HTML,
terrain, document or save fixture is injected. This is not a human playthrough.
assistance: Public v018LoadMacro/v046Load select real installed geographic sectors.
Public v018CaptureAt freezes simulation and places a measured collision-free camera with production LOS.
Public v047Control auto=false bounds background streaming; v046SetTime fixes daytime.
Public v042Update and v020Tick(.05,true) step actual production streaming/physics/AI.
Read-only public exports inspect actual actors, rigs and saves. No spawn/defeat/resource/quest debug API is used.
limitations: One actual regional silhouette is required and captured; this does not certify all 21 potential slots or all three species natively.
Wound/old-campaign/body/loot roundtrip and the other species are covered by separate production-wrapper VM regressions.
No native enemy kill, resource grant, quest outcome or fabricated historical storage import is performed.
Camera navigation, time and freeze are declared diagnostic assistance; no human or citywide 1:1 claim.
